strings.zh: 现在的技能机可以无限次使用！{NEWLINE}再也不用犹豫把技能机给哪个精灵了。
strings.en: TMs can be used as many times as you{NEWLINE}like now! No more agonizing over which{CLEAR}Pokémon gets a TM.

strings.zh: 哈哈,是你呀。{NEWLINE}我们在圣安努号上见过的,{CLEAR}多亏了你我们这一船人才能平安返航。{CLEAR}当时没有带什么能感谢你的东西,{CLEAR}正好现在我带着孙女在购物,{CLEAR}请你收下我的这份谢礼吧！
strings.en: Ha ha, it’s you! We met on the{NEWLINE}S.S. Anne. Thanks to you, everyone on{CLEAR}that ship made it home safely.{SCROLL}I didn’t have anything to thank you with{NEWLINE}back then. But I’m out shopping with my{CLEAR}granddaughter now, so please accept{CLEAR}this token of my thanks!

strings.zh: 大哥哥你好呀,{NEWLINE}咱们又见面了！{CLEAR}上次真的谢谢你了呢。
strings.en: Hello, mister! We meet again! Thank you{NEWLINE}so much for last time.

strings.zh: 技能机专柜{NEWLINE}有卖稀有物品哦。
strings.en: The TM Shop sells some rare items.
strings.notes: US 0496/3 | RV023: meaning: 稀有物品 = rare items, not moves

strings.zh: 使你的精灵更加强大！{NEWLINE}３楼……技能机专柜
strings.en: Make Your Pokémon Stronger!{NEWLINE}3F: TM Shop

strings.zh: 我给蛋蛋买了叶之石,有了它{NEWLINE}蛋蛋就可以进化成更强的椰蛋树了。{CLEAR}但是进化之后,{CLEAR}蛋蛋学习技能就会变得更晚,{CLEAR}所以要不要现在给它用叶之石呢……
strings.en: I bought a Leaf Stone for my{NEWLINE}Exeggcute. With it, Exeggcute can{CLEAR}evolve into the stronger Exeggutor.{SCROLL}But after it evolves, it’ll learn moves{NEWLINE}later...{SCROLL}So should I use the Leaf Stone on it now{NEWLINE}or not...?

strings.zh: 通过技能机丰富技能之后,{NEWLINE}我的怪力变得更强了！
strings.en: My Machamp got even stronger after I{NEWLINE}used TMs to give it more moves!

strings.zh: 有一些精灵技能,既不能升级获得,{NEWLINE}也不能通过技能机习得,{CLEAR}而是通过遗传的方式学会的。
strings.en: Some moves can’t be learned by leveling{NEWLINE}up or from TMs. Pokémon learn them by{CLEAR}inheriting them as Egg Moves.

strings.zh: 大姐姐你好呀,咱们又见面了！上次真的谢谢你了呢。
strings.en: Hello, miss! We meet again! Thank you so{NEWLINE}much for last time.

strings.zh: 你一定会成为一名伟大的训练家,{NEWLINE}我看好你哦。
strings.en: You’re going to be a great Trainer. I{NEWLINE}believe in you!
Welcome! What can I get for you?

strings.en: Here you go. Thank you for shopping{NEWLINE}with us.

strings.en: It looks like you don’t have enough{NEWLINE}money for that!
